home-paragraph-2: I target weak spots that stand in the way of exam success.
about-bio-text:
With an MSc in Computer Science and years of experience as a software engineer, I realised my greatest satisfaction comes from helping others learn.

Tutoring GCSE maths lets me combine my analytical skills with my passion for making complex concepts clear, and seeing students progress from confusion to clarity is deeply rewarding. Being a parent of a GCSE-aged daughter also helps me appreciate the challenges students face.

Beyond tutoring, I enjoy good films, spending time with my family and reading about academic subjects such as history, educational psychology and biology.
about-experience-text:
I often draw on Craig Barton’s work, applying research-based principles such as cognitive load theory to make concepts clear and accessible.

My lessons follow a structured format but are tailored to each student. A typical session includes a short recap, introduction of a new concept, guided practice, and independent work to consolidate learning. Most of the exercises I use come from past exam papers.

I hold an Enhanced DBS certificate (renewed Sep 2025, verifiable on request).
about-testimonials-intro: Quotes from parents I’ve worked with (shared with permission; names shortened for privacy):
about-testimonials-entry-1: Fabrice tutored my son in GCSE Maths, and I was highly impressed with his resourcefulness, dedication, and commitment. He effectively used a range of formative assessment strategies to identify gaps and address misunderstandings. Fabrice also demonstrated a strong understanding of learning theories, including cognitive overload theory, and applied strategies to improve information retrieval and retention. I highly recommend him as a tutor for anyone seeking academic improvement and deeper understanding in mathematics.
about-testimonials-author-1: Ammar M, 4 May 2025 — Dad and secondary school teacher (maths + science) with ~20 years’ experience
about-testimonials-entry-2: Fabrice tutored my daughter in the lead-up to her GCSE Maths exam. He was professional, always well-prepared and communicated clearly throughout. He broke down concepts in an accessible way, adapted to her pace and really helped boost her confidence before the exam. Thank you so much!
